notes: Cliopatria has no Menabe; the af-07-a Merina dossier enters 'Sakalava kingdom of Menabe' as a counterpart name (it should read menabe-kingdom). Pages: Menabe (the region article, with a short history section) and Sakalava people. The articles 'Menabe Kingdom', 'Kingdom of Menabe' and 'Sakalava Kingdom' do not exist (URL_NOT_FOUND). The Menabe page's dates (founding c. 1540, 1610-1685, campaigns of 1820-22, 1834, 1846, 1897, 1900) disagree with the Sakalava page ('first significant Sakalava kingdoms were formed around the 1650s'; the kingdom split 'After Andriantonkafo', 1722-1742); this dossier takes the Menabe page for the kingdom and mentions the Boina founding date from the Boina page. Merina conquest: the Menabe page has the Merina taking southern Menabe in 1834 and winning in 1846, which makes the Cliopatria Merina shape of 1824 (Morondava inside, per af-07-a) too early by a decade; no vassal event is entered for the post-1846 Merina governor (the Merina side's job). Ends 1900 (pacification). Gazetteer: names resolve (admin1 Menabe, Melaky, Boeny, Sofia, Betsiboka; place Morondava).
